title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Restoration of the Seller's Entitlement by Substitution
content:
Under the VA Home Loan Guaranty, when a qualifying veteran buyer assumes a VA loan and substitutes their own entitlement, the selling veteran's entitlement tied to that loan is restored to the seller and becomes available to the seller for a future VA loan. When the buyer substitutes, the part of the seller's entitlement that this restoration does not restore stays charged to the loan.

## Condition on the loan record

A seller's entitlement is not restored by substitution until the loan record shows the seller released from liability on the assumption.

Put another way: while the loan record does not show the seller released from liability on the assumption, no restoration by substitution is booked.

## What the restoration does

The restoration adds one restoration entry to the loan's entitlement history, dated today, on the ground of substitution by the assuming veteran, and links the entry to the assuming veteran's VA profile found under the full name given. The seller's entitlement tied up in the loan is reduced by the amount restored.

## Invocation

The restoration is booked with the agent-side tool `restore_entitlement_by_substitution_1ad1d2fb`. The representative unlocks it (`unlock_agent_discoverable_tool`) and then calls it (`call_agent_discoverable_tool`).

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `loan_id` | The reference number of the assumed VA home loan record, as returned by the loan lookup for the selling veteran | Identifier |
| `assuming_veteran_name` | The assuming veteran buyer's full name exactly as the selling veteran states it on the call | Verbatim text, copied character for character with nothing added or dropped |
| `entitlement_amount` | The amount of the seller's entitlement restored | USD, a positive number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

### Return

On success the tool returns a receipt with `entitlement_action_id` (the reference number of the new restoration entry), `loan_id` (the loan concerned), `substitute_customer_id` (the beneficiary reference number of the assuming veteran whose profile carries that full name, or None when no profile does), `entitlement_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places, the amount restored), `action_date` (today's date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `status`, which is always `entitlement_restored` when the entry was written. No other outcome is defined.

## Illustration (hypothetical values)

A call with the assumed loan's reference, a buyer's full name as the seller stated it and `entitlement_amount` 36,000.00 returns `status` `entitlement_restored`, `entitlement_amount` 36,000.00 and, where a VA profile carries that exact name, that veteran's reference as `substitute_customer_id`.
